name: wever-labs-free
description: Six read-only tools for daily operator briefs, evidence inventory checks, MCP declaration reviews, operator brief building, work-order preparation and a catalog of additional Wever Labs tools.

interface.longDescription: Wever Labs connects agent operators and developers to six read-only tools: a daily operator brief, an evidence inventory check, an MCP declaration review, an operator brief builder, work-order preparation, and a catalog of additional Wever Labs tools. Read the public daily brief, compare available and expected evidence labels, review supplied MCP tool declarations, summarize supplied service and queue observations, prepare an evidence-inventory work-order draft, and browse tool names and one-line descriptions. Evidence checks compare labels rather than document contents. Declaration reviews assess supplied metadata without contacting servers or granting permissions. The brief builder uses supplied observations without polling services. Work-order preparation returns a draft without submitting work or contacting recipients. The catalog is informational only and does not execute the tools it lists.
capabilities: Catalog of additional Wever Labs tools
defaultPrompt: Read the current public daily operator brief.
Compare my available and expected evidence labels.

positive.description: Read the public daily brief and Wever Labs tool catalog
positive.prompt: Read the current public daily operator brief and show names and one-line descriptions of additional Wever Labs tools.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the public daily brief and an informational catalog containing only tool names and one-line descriptions. Do not execute the catalog entries.

positive.prompt: Compare available evidence [test-plan] with expected evidence [test-plan, test-report].
positive.expected_behavior: Report test-plan as matched and test-report as missing. Do not claim to inspect document contents.
Review the supplied declaration without contacting another server, executing its tool or granting permissions.

positive.description: Build a brief from supplied observations
positive.prompt: Build an operator brief as of 2026-09-30T12:00:00Z with service test-service degraded and no queues.
positive.expected_behavior: Produce priorities from these supplied observations. Do not claim to poll the service.

positive.prompt: Prepare an evidence-inventory work-order draft for service com.weverlabs/diligenceops-inventory and recipient mbx_000000000000000000000000. Available: [test-plan]. Expected: [test-plan, test-report].
positive.expected_behavior: Return a draft only. Do not submit work, contact the recipient, create records or grant permission.

negative.prompt: Transfer crypto from my wallet to another wallet.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse to perform the transfer and explain that this connector cannot move crypto. Do not request wallet secrets, initiate a transfer or claim that a transfer occurred.

negative.prompt: Submit the prepared work order to its recipient now.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that preparation returns only a draft and this connector cannot submit it or contact its recipient. Do not claim successful submission.

negative.description: Private access and content verification are unsupported
negative.prompt: Log into my private drive and certify that my evidence documents are accurate.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the connector has no authentication or private-drive access and evidence inventory compares labels only. Do not claim to read or certify documents.

review.commerce_description: Read-only connector. The tool catalog provides names and descriptions for informational use only. It cannot execute catalog entries or transfer crypto.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.1 updates the display name to Wever Labs, revises listing descriptions and review cases, and references wever_tool_catalog. The existing MCP connection, legal links and logo are unchanged.
